title: Café Nader — Cancún
setting: A small independent café a few blocks from Avenida Náder in downtown Cancún, 5:30 pm. Table service. Maria greets you at the door and walks you to the window table where Luis is already sitting.

npcs.name: Maria
npcs.role: Waitress at Café Nader. You meet her first; she seats you with Luis and takes your order.
npcs.first_message: ¡Buenas tardes! Pásale, joven. Tu amigo ya está en la mesa, ven conmigo. ¿Qué te sirvo?

npcs.name: Luis
npcs.role: Marine biologist from Guadalajara. The person you came to meet, already at the table.
npcs.first_message: ¡Hola! ¿Qué tal? Siéntate, siéntate. Qué bueno que llegaste.

goals.label: Order something in Spanish
goals.evidence_required: The learner names a menu item inside a request form (quiero, quisiera, me da, me pones, para mí, un X por favor), and serve_order fires within the next two turns. Pointing, English, or only saying 'sí' to a suggestion does not count.

goals.label: Ask what something costs, before being told
goals.evidence_required: The learner asks a price question (¿cuánto cuesta…?, ¿cuánto es?, ¿cuánto le debo?, ¿a cómo está…?) before Maria volunteers the total.

goals.label: Handle an unexpected fast question
goals.evidence_required: Maria asks one of her clarifying questions and the learner answers appropriately within two turns, in Spanish.

goals.label: Hold a personal conversation
goals.evidence_required: At least two full-clause statements about themselves across at least three back-and-forth exchanges. One-word answers do not count.

goals.label: Ask a follow-up about something Luis said
goals.evidence_required: The learner's question refers to content from one of Luis's previous two turns. Quote both his line and their question. A bare '¿y tú?' does not count.

goals.label: Recover in Spanish when lost
goals.evidence_required: The learner uses a Spanish repair phrase at least once (¿cómo?, ¿mande?, ¿puedes repetir?, más despacio por favor, no entendí). Switching to English does not count.

serve_order.description: Place the customer's complete order on the table. Call once, when the order is final. Always pass the FULL order, not just newly added items — this call replaces any previous one. Returns the total price in pesos.

items.description: Menu item ids, one entry per unit ordered. Two conchas is ["concha","concha"].

to_go.description: True if the customer said para llevar.

show_bill.description: Show the customer the bill for what they have ordered. Call when they ask what they owe, or try to leave without asking. Returns the total in pesos.

play_gesture.description: Make your body perform a gesture while you speak. At most one per reply.

gesture.description: One of: wave, nod, shake_head, laugh, think, shrug, point_menu, lean_in
